commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yusi (Alaves) was quite harsh and Jose Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
